name: Product goal and metric baseline
mitigation: Maintain MASTER_Product_Goal_and_Metrics.md and Product_Goal_Metric_Stack.csv as repo planning source; regenerate progress data on every closeout
risk_if_late: Metrics drift or velocity-only pressure can create false-green delivery claims

name: Vertical-slice ladder baseline
mitigation: Keep Vertical_Slice_Ladder.csv metric-linked with entry and exit gates before adding cadence overlays
risk_if_late: Future work can claim roadmap progress without proving a vertical learning or safety claim

name: Source and evidence governance
mitigation: Use SourceRef resolver evidence and fixture-governance tasks before source-backed claims affect closure or readiness
risk_if_late: Raw or unresolved source material can be mistaken for reviewed evidence

name: Closure and pointer safety
mitigation: Preserve closure and pointer sequence tests plus project-scoped official pointer guards before officialness claims expand
risk_if_late: Later evidence or latest artifacts can be misread as retroactive closure or official state

name: Procurement and workflow routing
mitigation: Keep procurement escalation planning routed through canonical tasks and approvals; leave threshold signoff to TASK-0659
risk_if_late: Workpages or planning notes can become editable status shortcuts for business decisions

name: Fixture governance
mitigation: Use the three-project governance runbook and require sanitized fixture manifests and frozen validation protocols before fixture outcomes are treated as evidence
risk_if_late: Overfit fixture demos can hide cross-project defects or leak sensitive corpus context

name: Workpage guardrails
mitigation: Keep workpage commands behind projection cursor activation guardrails and accepted DoR or DoD quality checks
risk_if_late: Workpage convenience controls can bypass canonical task approval artifact event or pointer truth

name: Storage restore and preflight evidence
mitigation: Run real restore and preflight evidence or record explicit waivers before any production-ready claim
risk_if_late: Artifact or source storage can be unrecoverable or unauthorized after restore

name: Production preflight
mitigation: Close production preflight blockers across capacity release storage raw-corpus and environment gates before activation
risk_if_late: Runtime or product launch can proceed with unresolved safety and environment blockers

name: Backlog and cadence quality
mitigation: Use one authoritative backlog hierarchy with cadence first-90-day review and accepted DoR or DoD checks before roadmap commitments
risk_if_late: Duplicate planning systems or demo-only stories can replace governed delivery evidence
